maddeler.e:
استشهدتا (form X)
# اِسْتَشْهَدَتَا (istašhadatā) /is.taʃ.ha.da.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# اُسْتُشْهِدَتَا (ustušhidatā) /us.tuʃ.hi.da.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
